name: Can I live in my home during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can stay in your home during a renovation depends entirely on the scope of the project. If the renovation is limited to one or two rooms, like a single bathroom or a bedroom, it might be feasible to remain in your home, although expect some disruption, noise, and dust. However, for whole-house renovations, major kitchen remodels, or projects involving significant utility shut-offs (water, electricity, gas), it is often recommended to arrange for temporary accommodation. Discuss logistics with your contractor to understand the impact on daily living.
acceptedAnswer.description: Staying home during renovation depends on the project's scope. Minor work might allow it, but major renovations, especially those affecting essential utilities, often require temporary relocation.
